Remove ALL user interface: the top 0..52 header, right x1320..1672 management panel, bottom y834..941 navigation, and ALL eight vertical cream nameplates. Replace these border areas with natural landscape continuation, NOT blank white. Within the world area x0..1320,y52..834 remove ALL eight functional buildings/site contents completely: upper center main hall roof/walls/foundation; upper-left two-storey library; middle-left multi-wing residence; lower-left log yard and logs/shed; lower-left-middle golden crop fields and water wheel; lower center training dummies/fence/racks; lower-right forge/furnace/smoke; upper-right mine entrance/shed/crystals/scaffold. Keep the GROUND TERRACES and cross-terrace connecting stairways, roads, mountain rocks and retaining walls. Fill each cleared site with flat grey limestone, bare earth or short grass, at the EXACT SAME ground height. No remaining building ghosts. Do not enlarge trees into any former building footprint. Keep blue-grey mountains and sage-green pines, subtle small pond at right, same warm upper-left daylight, clear detailed game materials at original scale. No new buildings, UI, text, people. This is the empty/unbuilt version of the SAME scene, not a newly composed image. Output same wide framing.

8bc984b9-31ff-46a1-a076-39b2b7b2d624.name: output.png
8bc984b9-31ff-46a1-a076-39b2b7b2d624.prompt:
Using the reference ONLY as architectural style and design reference, create ONE production RGBA transparent sprite atlas for a 2.5D Chinese sect management game. Exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight separate cells, no printed grid, no text/UI/labels/numbers. The canvas aspect is 16:9. ALL space outside the eight objects must be TRUE transparent alpha, not white, no checkerboard. Keep objects fully inside their respective cells with generous empty padding, no touching neighbors. Same orthographic elevated three-quarter camera, upper-left daylight, blue-grey roof tiles, warm timber, cream plaster, grey low stone plinths, fine semi-realistic stylized game rendering.
TOP ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) the large main hall from the upper center of the reference, complete roof, walls, foundation and front stairs; (2) the two-storey scripture library from upper-left, full building and front steps; (3) a compact residence compound of two small matching residential wings with short connecting wall, as reference middle-left; (4) the lumber yard, one rustic log shed plus neat log piles and short workbench, no surrounding forest.
BOTTOM ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: (5) spirit mine, compact rocky mine entrance with timber support and small sorting shed, a few restrained blue mineral clusters, no giant cliff or terrain; (6) grain farm, neat golden-green grain rows on a small irregular earth planting bed with a tiny low shed, no water wheel; (7) the training court, low grey rectangular paving footprint with wood practice dummies, racks and low fence, no surrounding landscape; (8) forge workshop with blue-grey roof, warm small furnace and a chimney, no huge smoke, include complete low foundation.
Each cell is one grouped functional object with its full silhouette. Transparent outside footprint. No massive square tile/slab under any building, no surrounding trees or mountains or waterfalls, no external ground shadow haze. Match the quiet believable materials and proportions of the supplied concept so all eight belong to ONE game. Objects face generally toward front of image, same scale language, do not stylize as miniature toys or chibi. All architecture normal proportions. This is an atlas of independent buildings/precinct objects, NOT a complete scene. No names, calligraphy, plaques or UI.
